Выберите период под заголовком. Кнопка ф: Choose a period below the heading. The filters button lets you select a model, operation type, time zone and chart detail. Hiding the filters keeps your selections.

Сейчас Usage показывает учтённые вызовы: Usage currently shows recorded Production and assistant calls. A breakdown by calling app is not available yet. Calls from other apps using the same API key are not included automatically.
В настройках AI Providers можно посмотре: In AI Providers settings, you can review member spending and set individual limits. Members share the workspace budget; a limit does not reserve funds.
Управлять лимитами могут пользователи с: Users with the appropriate permissions can manage limits. New requests stop when a limit is reached.
Стоимость уточняется после вызова: после: The final cost is confirmed after each call, so the last operation may exceed the limit. Until its cost is known, new paid requests are paused for members with a limit.
Опишите, что хотите создать, или выберит: Describe what you want to create, or choose an image, Flow, Storyboard or Timeline. The assistant will help turn your idea into a result.
Добавьте референсы и уточните направлени: Add references and refine your direction. You can find all your conversations in Chats.
Соединяйте шаги генерации на холсте: рез: Connect generation steps on the canvas: the output of one becomes the input for the next. Set up models and references, then run the steps you need.
Готовый процесс можно опубликовать как п: Publish your workflow as a pipeline to run it again or use it in connected apps.
Пайплайн — сохранённый рецепт из вашего: A pipeline is a saved recipe from your Flow: it takes inputs, runs the steps you configured and produces a result.
В Playground можно проверять этот рецепт: In Playground, you can try that recipe with different inputs without opening the canvas. Edit the workflow itself in your Flow.
Нажмите «Выбрать из проектов» и найдите: Click “Choose from projects” and find a pipeline by name. Or open “Use a link” and paste its link.
Рядом с названием показана сохранённая в: The saved version appears next to the name. If the list is empty, open your Flow and save the section you need using Make executable, with its inputs and outputs configured.
В блоке Input появятся поля, которые нуж: The Input panel shows the fields your selected pipeline needs: text, settings or files. For example, a scene description and a reference image.
Заполните обязательные поля и дождитесь: Fill in the required fields and wait for your files to upload. The “Run pipeline” button will then become available.
После запуска в блоке Output появятся ст: After a run starts, the Output panel shows its status and results: images, video, audio or text, depending on your pipeline.
Медиа можно просмотреть и скачать. Если: You can preview and download media. If the run fails, its error details appear here.
Измените входные материалы и запустите т: Change the inputs and run the same pipeline again to see whether the workflow suits your regular tasks. AI results can vary between runs.
Запуски используют AI-бюджет пространств: Runs use the workspace AI budget. Connections to other products and API key management are in Settings, under Connections.
Здесь живут ваши материалы и результаты: Find your materials and generated results here. Switch between gallery and date views, and open cards to preview them.
Поиск и фильтры помогают найти нужное по: Use search and filters to find media by type, model or source. Reuse saved characters in future work.
Обсудите историю с соавтором: кто герой,: Discuss your story with the co-author: who is the main character, what do they want, and who is the story for? Upload text or visual references.
Сохраните замысел в Blueprint, подготовь: Save your concept in Blueprint, develop your characters and arrange scenes in Storyboard. Refine descriptions and references with the assistant.
Разместите готовые фрагменты на дорожках: Place clips on tracks, adjust their order and duration, and add audio. Use the preview to check the sequence.
Timeline — отдельный документ. Его можно: A Timeline is a separate document. Link it to a story or use it for an independent edit.
Объединяйте Flows, истории, монтажи и ча: Keep Flows, stories, timelines and chats together in projects. Use folders to separate materials for different tasks.
Действия с проектом доступны в меню его: Open a project card’s menu for more actions. You can collapse Projects and Chats in the sidebar.

В меню раздела можно переключиться между: Use the section menu to switch between recent chats, the archive and the trash.
Account and security settings belong to you. AI Providers, member limits and connected services belong to the selected workspace.

Источник — журналы генераций Production: The data comes from Production generation logs and assistant calls in the selected workspace. One request means one actual model call. Retries count separately; status polling and cost reconciliation do not. Queued work is not counted until it is sent to the provider.
Запрос попадает в день первого наблюдени: A request is assigned to the day its call was first recorded; a result is assigned to the day it finished. Results include successful image generation and editing, Generate Text and formatting, audio and video. Analysis, transcription, chat replies, imports and saved copies do not increase the result count.
Расходы включают известную стоимость усп: Spending includes the known cost of successful and failed calls. It is not your remaining balance. “≥” means a known subtotal; “—” means no data. Zero amounts in the older chat log are treated as unknown. Token counts do not replace video and audio costs.
Вызовы без записей журнала нельзя восста: Calls without log records cannot be reconstructed accurately. Cache and reasoning usage are not shown separately because consistent, reliable fields are not yet available.
Сравниваем с непосредственно предшествую: We compare with the immediately preceding period of the same length. If the current period is still in progress, we compare equal portions. Model and operation filters apply to both periods.
Изменение = (текущее − предыдущее) / пре: Change = (current − previous) / previous × 100%. “Previously 0” means growth from zero; “No comparison” means there is not enough data. Higher spending alone does not mean better performance.
